notes: Pilot pilot-bbu2-v3 (guard_factor 0.80; BH/RS seeds 0-9, 60k steps). NEP89 GM: a0a0c- tilted perovskite (I4/mcm, the experimental low-T phase): Ti-O 1.958 A, Sr-O >= 2.61 A, O [Sr4Ti2], V 11.91 A^3/atom (exp. 11.91), d_min ratio 0.87. e_tol 0.02 eV (1 meV/atom) also accepts the other tilt systems (Pnma/R-3c-like +8 meV, cubic +14 meV per cell); runs that found I4/mcm agree within 1 meV. Misses: strained perovskites (+31, +47 meV) and non-perovskite frameworks with 4/5-coordinated Ti (3 RS runs, +0.67 eV). References per cell: ilmenite +0.84 eV, 2H hexagonal (symmetry-constrained; unstable) +4.86 eV, SrO + TiO2 (anatase) +4.85 eV. With the default guard 0.75 NEP89 has a short-range Sr-O hole (Sr-O 1.93 A = 0.74 x covalent-radius sum, found in the 10-atom bu_Sr2Ti2O6), hence guard_factor 0.80.
